subject: Future Tech
title: Feynman's Quantum Dream
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Feynman's Quantum Dream.

hook.text: In 1981, physicist Richard Feynman stood before a conference and asked a bold question about simulating nature.

buildup.text: He argued simulating quantum particles on classical computers takes exponentially more time as the system grows.

discovery.text: His insight: build a computer that runs on quantum rules and it could simulate quantum systems naturally.

twist.text: Most scientists dismissed it as a thought experiment. No one knew how to build such a machine for decades.

climax.text: Today quantum simulators model molecules, materials, and reactions exactly as Feynman envisioned.

punchline.text: Feynman bet on nature as the blueprint.

quiz.question: In what year did Feynman propose the quantum computer idea?
